newsitem.title: USA: Pomeroy files for 1.1 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Pomeroy files for 1.1 mln shr offering.

text.p: Pomeroy Computer Resources Inc said on Friday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering the public offering of 1.1 million shares of its common stock.

Of the shares being offered, 1,020,000 shares are being offered by the company and 80,000 shares are being offered by chairman, president and chief executive officer David Pomeroy II, the company said.

The company said it will also grant the underwriters an over-allotment option to purchase an additional 165,000 shares, Pomeroy said. J.C. Bradford & Co and Tucker Anthony Inc will manage the offering.
As of the third quarter ended October 5, 1996, Pomeroy had approximately 6.5 million shares outstanding.
